title: </sub>  Preserve the rejection that triggered sibling cancellation
text:
</sub>  Preserve the rejection that triggered sibling cancellation

With multiple precision fixtures, a later-index request can fail first with `model_unavailable`, aborting an earlier-index sibling whose client then rejects with `timed_out`. The new `Promise.allSettled(...).find(...)` selects the rejection by input order rather than failure order, so `runOneCampaignRun` can record this ordinary provider failure as a timeout and hide the actual cause. Capture the first chronologically observed rejection before aborting the siblings, then rethrow that error after draining them.
rationale: Author fixed it: Fixed. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
